hints.title: Slot Capacity Mapping
hints.text: Store available slots for big (1), medium (2), and small (3) cars in an array.

hints.title: Slot Availability Check
hints.text: Check if slots for carType are greater than 0.

hints.title: Decrement and Return
hints.text: If slots exist, decrement capacity by 1 and return true; otherwise return false.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: Direct indexing and decrement execute in constant time and space.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: No complex branching needed for simple fixed capacity checking.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Constant sized array storage provides optimal O(1) performance.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Clean 1-indexed array mapping of car types.
